notes._summary: CommonMark 0.31.2 baseline measured against Supramark's `supramark-commonmark` profile: the parser runs with the GFM bare-URL/email autolink extension toggled OFF (`--no-gfm-autolink`) so CommonMark-core cases are measured against CommonMark semantics, where bare `https://`, `www.` and `foo@bar` stay literal. Supramark's shipped default keeps the extension ON (the product's GFM profile); the cmark-gfm and micromark sources still run with the default config and their GFM-vs-CommonMark autolink divergences stay baselined there. Issue #202: the commonmark source's 4 Autolinks failures (0602/0608/0611/0612) were exactly this GFM-vs-CommonMark difference; profiling them as CommonMark resolves them, so this baseline now records 0 failures.
